{{Quote|Using sophisticated droids and computers, the New Republic 'sifting teams' have managed to piece together a partial inventory of some of the awesome treasures stored in Mount Tantiss. Garv Debble, the New Republic xenoarchaeologist in charge of the Mount Tantiss dig, has compiled a report concerning what is known to have been damaged or destroyed in the blast, though he admits the list is by no means comprehensive.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="Field Report" />}}
The '''Mount Tantiss dig''' was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition<ref name="Field Report" /> undertaken by the [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]] in the ruins of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]<ref name="TLCS" /> several [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]]<ref name="Erasing All Traces" /> after the [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|destruction of Mount Tantiss]]<ref name="TLCS" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" /> The expedition was led by the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Garv Debble]] and his [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] [[Milanda Vorgan]].<ref name="Erasing All Traces" />

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] search teams spent a few days recovering various artifacts from the ruins of Mount Tantiss. The next morning, the [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] discovered a new chamber in the mountain, and believed they had found the [[Duinarbulon Stones]]. Lead archaeologist Garv Debble was excited at the prospect as the discovery of the Stones would be the first proof that the [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]] were, indeed, real. However, the [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] thought to be the gems were not the Duinarbulon Stones. Debble's expedition was nearly thwarted by [[Ekhrikhor]], a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], who wanted all of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] belongings destroyed. Debble protested,<ref name="Erasing All Traces" /> and [[Councillor/Legends|Councillor]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] eventually had to intervene and allow Debble the opportunity to complete his work. The [[Debble Agreement]] was negotiated by Organa Solo between Debble, who wished to preserve the artifacts, and the Noghri cleansing teams who sought to destroy all indication of Palpatine's presence there.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> The New Republic [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later mentioned the Mount Tantiss dig in<ref name="Field Report" /> his<ref name="CSWE Na'al">{{CSWECite|II|351|Na'al, Voren}}</ref> [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]].<ref name="Field Report" />
